Dev Patel: Need quick consensus today on the new P0/P1 wording for the escalation playbook + when Support should pull SRE into a customer ticket. Dropping proposed definitions below—please react :thumbsup: if ok or reply w/ edits.

Dev Patel: **Proposal (Support Priority)**
**P0 (Customer-impacting outage / severe degradation):** Customer cannot use core functionality OR widespread severe degradation with no viable workaround. Examples: auth outage, 5xx across a region, streaming hard-failing for most requests, Dedicated pool effectively down. **Action:** start Slack bridge + page on-call immediately (per escalation matrix). Updates to customer at least every 30–60 min depending on tier.

Dev Patel: **P1 (High impact / partial outage):** Significant degradation affecting customer production traffic with limited or risky workaround. Examples: elevated latency/error rate for a subset of models/regions, intermittent timeouts, Dedicated autoscaling instability causing SLO misses, Private upgrade blocked for production environment. **Action:** open bridge if impact trending up or multiple customers; otherwise keep in SUP ticket w/ clear update cadence + escalation trigger.

Dev Patel: **When to involve SRE (Hosted/Dedicated/Shared infra):**
- Any P0
- P1 if (a) metrics indicate platform/regional issue (error rate/latency) OR (b) 2+ customers reporting same symptom in <1 hr OR (c) no mitigation within 30 min
- Any suspected incident-worthy issue (might need #incidents + status page)

Dev Patel: Question: Are we good with “no mitigation within 30 min” as the P1->page trigger? Or should we tie it to concrete signals (error budget alerts / dashboards)?

Owen Phillips: +1 on the structure. I’d tweak wording so P0 = “no workaround OR workaround requires Redwood-side change” (so we don’t label as P0 if there’s a safe toggle and customer can ship immediately). For paging: “no mitigation within 30 min” feels right, but only if we mean “no *credible* mitigation plan” not “no fix.”

Priya Shah: Agree. Also can we call out required context when paging SRE? (region, model, request IDs, last known good, SDK version). We keep getting pages that are basically “customer says it’s broken” :)

Dev Patel: Yep. Intake checklist already has it but we can paste a short version into the escalation section.

Sean Gallagher: From SRE side: tying P1 paging to “no mitigation in 30 min” is ok IF we define mitigation as “reduce blast radius / stabilize.” Not necessarily root cause.

Sean Gallagher: I’d add another explicit trigger: **“suspected shared infrastructure / multi-tenant impact”**. If Support suspects it’s not customer-specific (e.g., multiple accounts, single region, sudden jump), page us earlier.

Rafael Mendes: +1. Also, please avoid “page SRE” as default for P1. Prefer “page owning on-call (SRE vs Platform vs Runtime) per matrix.” SRE gets pulled into too many quota/SSO tickets that are really Platform.

Dev Patel: Good call—will change to “page owning on-call per escalation paths; SRE for infra/regional symptoms.”

Rachel Kim: For enterprise: can we keep “every 30–60 min” language flexible? Some contracts say 60 min updates but exec escalations usually demand 30. I’d phrase: “enterprise P0: every 30 min unless otherwise agreed” and keep a note that comms cadence must match contract + comms alignment doc.

Allison Grant: Suggest we reference the dashboards we expect Support to check before paging (error rate by region, p95 latency, streaming health, audit log lag). Even a link placeholder is fine for now.

Dev Patel: Great. Proposed edits based on feedback:
- P0 wording: “no viable workaround OR workaround is risky/Redwood-side change required”
- P1 trigger: “no credible mitigation plan within 30 min”
- “page owning on-call per matrix” + explicit “suspected shared infra/multi-tenant/regional” trigger
- add “required paging context” mini-template + dashboard links

Dev Patel: Can folks react to confirm? Need to finalize for Confluence severity matrix today.

Owen Phillips: :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: :thumbsup:

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: (with the ‘mitigation plan’ wording)

Rafael Mendes: :thumbsup: also pls add: if customer provides request IDs, include 2–3 recent ones + timeframe.

Rachel Kim: :thumbsup: (and +1 to keeping enterprise cadence aligned with contract language)

Dev Patel: Done. I’ll incorporate + post updated snippet in #announcements once published. Thanks all.
